text.en: Droṇa makes a vow. Today he will bring down one of the Pāṇḍavas' greatest warriors.
text.hi: द्रोण प्रतिज्ञा करते हैं। आज वे पांडवों के एक महान योद्धा को गिराएँगे।

text.en: To draw Arjuna away, the Saṃśaptakas challenge him and lead him south.
text.hi: अर्जुन को दूर ले जाने के लिए संशप्तक उन्हें ललकारते हैं और दक्षिण की ओर ले जाते हैं।

text.en: Droṇa sets the army in the cakravyūha, the wheel, with kings and princes inside it.
text.hi: द्रोण सेना को चक्रव्यूह में सजाते हैं, जिसके भीतर राजा और राजकुमार खड़े हैं।

text.en: Only four could break it, Yudhiṣṭhira says: Arjuna, Kṛṣṇa, Pradyumna, or Abhimanyu. And Arjuna is gone.
text.hi: युधिष्ठिर कहते हैं, इसे केवल चार तोड़ सकते हैं: अर्जुन, कृष्ण, प्रद्युम्न या अभिमन्यु। और अर्जुन यहाँ नहीं हैं।

text.en: So he turns to Abhimanyu, a boy not yet grown.
text.hi: तब वे अभिमन्यु की ओर देखते हैं, जो अभी युवा भी नहीं हुआ है।

text.en: Abhimanyu answers. His father taught him how to break in. But if trouble comes, he cannot get out.
text.hi: अभिमन्यु उत्तर देता है। पिता ने उसे व्यूह तोड़कर भीतर जाना सिखाया है। पर संकट आने पर वह बाहर नहीं निकल पाएगा।

text.en: He breaks the wheel in many places and rides in alone.
text.hi: वह चक्रव्यूह को कई जगह से तोड़ देता है और अकेला भीतर चला जाता है।

text.en: Behind him, the gap closes. No one can follow.
text.hi: उसके पीछे दरार भर दी जाती है। कोई उसके पीछे नहीं जा पाता।

text.en: Six great warriors close in around him. When his weapons are gone, he lifts a chariot wheel.
text.hi: छह महारथी उसे घेर लेते हैं। जब उसके शस्त्र नहीं रहते, तो वह रथ का पहिया उठा लेता है।
वे उस पहिए के भी टुकड़े कर देते हैं।

text.en: One against six, he falls. And the voices in the sky say: this was not dharma.
text.hi: छह के विरुद्ध अकेला, वह गिर जाता है। और आकाश से स्वर उठते हैं: यह धर्म नहीं था।

text.en: Many grew up hearing that he learned the wheel in his mother's womb. The critical edition tells it differently: his father taught him to break in, and he learned arms from Arjuna as a boy.
text.hi: बहुतों ने सुना है कि उसने चक्रव्यूह माँ के गर्भ में सीखा था। समीक्षात्मक संस्करण कुछ और कहता है: पिता ने उसे भीतर जाना सिखाया, और बचपन में उसने अर्जुन से शस्त्र-विद्या सीखी।

text.en: They could not follow him in. Who held the gate?
text.hi: वे उसके पीछे भीतर नहीं जा सके। द्वार किसने रोका था?

text.en: Abhimanyu learned the way in while still in his mother's womb, as Arjuna described it to Subhadrā. In some tellings she falls asleep; in others Kṛṣṇa interrupts before the way out.

source.label: Popular telling: regional retellings, kathā, folk theatre, film and television

text.en: Abhimanyu tells Yudhiṣṭhira his father taught him to break in, but that he cannot get out (7.34.19). Elsewhere he learns arms from Arjuna as a boy (1.213.65). The critical edition's text does not tell the womb story.

mbh.1.213.65.devanagari: चतुष्पादं दशविधं धनुर्वेदमरिंदमः । अर्जुनाद्वेद वेदज्ञात्सकलं दिव्यमानुषम् ॥ ६५ ॥
mbh.1.213.65.iast: catuṣpādaṃ daśavidhaṃ dhanurvedam ariṃdamaḥ / arjunād veda vedajñāt sakalaṃ divyamānuṣam

mbh.4.67.7.devanagari: अभिषङ्गादहं भीतो मिथ्याचारात्परंतप । स्नुषार्थमुत्तरां राजन्प्रतिगृह्णामि ते सुताम् ॥ ७ ॥
mbh.4.67.7.iast: abhiṣaṅgād ahaṃ bhīto mithyācārāt paraṃtapa / snuṣārtham uttarāṃ rājan pratigṛhṇāmi te sutām

mbh.7.32.12.devanagari: सत्यं तु ते ब्रवीम्यद्य नैतज्जात्वन्यथा भवेत् । अद्यैषां प्रवरं वीरं पातयिष्ये महारथम् ॥ १२ ॥
mbh.7.32.12.iast: satyaṃ tu te bravīmy adya naitaj jātv anyathā bhavet / adyaiṣāṃ pravaraṃ vīraṃ pātayiṣye mahāratham

mbh.7.32.15.devanagari: द्रोणेन व्याहृते त्वेवं संशप्तकगणाः पुनः । आह्वयन्नर्जुनं संख्ये दक्षिणामभितो दिशम् ॥ १५ ॥
mbh.7.32.15.iast: droṇena vyāhṛte tv evaṃ saṃśaptakagaṇāḥ punaḥ / āhvayann arjunaṃ saṃkhye dakṣiṇām abhito diśam

mbh.7.32.18.devanagari: तं चाभिमन्युर्वचनात्पितुर्ज्येष्ठस्य भारत । बिभेद दुर्भिदं संख्ये चक्रव्यूहमनेकधा ॥ १८ ॥
mbh.7.32.18.iast: taṃ cābhimanyur vacanāt pitur jyeṣṭhasya bhārata / bibheda durbhidaṃ saṃkhye cakravyūham anekadhā

mbh.7.32.19.devanagari: स कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म हत्वा वीरान्सहस्रशः । षट्सु वीरेषु संसक्तो दौःशासनिवशं गतः ॥ १९ ॥
mbh.7.32.19.iast: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrān sahasraśaḥ / ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ

summary.en: Dhṛtarāṣṭra calls Abhimanyu not yet come of age (aprāptayauvana) and a boy (bāla), struck down by many skilled in arms.

The arrangement of the cakravyūha: kings and princes set around Duryodhana, Droṇa at the head of the army and Jayadratha, king of Sindhu, standing firm beside him. The adhyāya gives no count of rings.

mbh.7.34.15.devanagari: त्वं वार्जुनो वा कृष्णो वा भिन्द्यात्प्रद्युम्न एव वा । चक्रव्यूहं महाबाहो पञ्चमोऽन्यो न विद्यते ॥ १५ ॥
mbh.7.34.15.iast: tvaṃ vārjuno vā kṛṣṇo vā bhindyāt pradyumna eva vā / cakravyūhaṃ mahābāho pañcamo 'nyo na vidyate

summary.en: Yudhiṣṭhira asks Abhimanyu to break Droṇa's array; Abhimanyu agrees, says his father taught him how to break in but that he cannot get out if trouble comes; Yudhiṣṭhira promises they will follow him in.

mbh.7.34.19.devanagari: उपदिष्टो हि मे पित्रा योगोऽनीकस्य भेदने । नोत्सहे तु विनिर्गन्तुमहं कस्यांचिदापदि ॥ १९ ॥
mbh.7.34.19.iast: upadiṣṭo hi me pitrā yogo 'nīkasya bhedane / notsahe tu vinirgantum ahaṃ kasyāṃ cid āpadi

translation.en: My father taught me the method of breaking the array, but if any calamity befalls me I cannot come out.

summary.en: Saṃjaya tells how Jayadratha held back the Pāṇḍavas who tried to follow Abhimanyu, retelling Śiva's boon to him.

mbh.7.42.6.devanagari: स विस्फार्य महच्चापं किरन्निषुगणान्बहून् । तत्खण्डं पूरयामास यद्व्यदारयदार्जुनिः ॥ ६ ॥
mbh.7.42.6.iast: sa visphārya mahac cāpaṃ kirann iṣugaṇān bahūn / tat khaṇḍaṃ pūrayām āsa yad vyadārayad ārjuniḥ

summary.en: Weaponless, Abhimanyu takes up a chariot wheel and rushes at Droṇa.

mbh.7.48.3.devanagari: तच्चक्रं भृशमुद्विग्नाः संचिच्छिदुरनेकधा । महारथस्ततः कार्ष्णिः संजग्राह महागदाम् ॥ ३ ॥
mbh.7.48.3.iast: tac cakraṃ bhṛśam udvignāḥ saṃcicchidur anekadhā / mahārathas tataḥ kārṣṇiḥ saṃjagrāha mahāgadām

summary.en: As Abhimanyu rises, Duḥśāsana's son strikes him on the head with a mace and he falls; thus one was slain by many.

mbh.7.48.21.devanagari: द्रोणकर्णमुखैः षड्भिर्धार्तराष्ट्रैर्महारथैः । एकोऽयं निहतः शेते नैष धर्मो मतो हि नः ॥ २१ ॥
mbh.7.48.21.iast: droṇakarṇamukhaiḥ ṣaḍbhir dhārtarāṣṭrair mahārathaiḥ / eko 'yaṃ nihataḥ śete naiṣa dharmo mato hi naḥ

translation.en: One against six he lies slain; this, we hold, was not dharma.

summary.en: Abhimanyu's son Parikṣit is born dead, struck by Aśvatthāman's weapon, and Kṛṣṇa restores him to life (birth at 14.65.8, revival at 14.68.18–24 and 14.69.3).
